expectations.text: The refusal names what specifically would change the answer, in checkable terms rather than a vague standard like a more established outlet.
expectations.evidence: Most decline templates name concrete, checkable fixes. 'Couldn't verify' asks for '[a link to recent published work / a byline / a note from your editor]'. 'Lane A without press proof' asks for 'proof of a current assignment or byline', or for the creator track, 'a link to your work and a short plan for coverage'. 'Past recipient' says 'send us the link'. The policy also lists checkable Lane B criteria: posted in the last 90 days, public contact matches the applicant, content is about software or tech. One gap: the 'Not a fit' template says only 'we don't think your content is the right match'
